# Interactive model match chart · 0.37.0

Open Developer → Interactive model match chart to compare all 148 public fictional models and, after owner sign-in, six owner-only variations. The chart is a current replay of frozen answers, not a historical event log or observed student behavior.

The main table shows each model's chosen field, up to three Top matches, the six Other matches displayed on the student page, and the careers surfaced by Matches by education that can sustain the selected lifestyle at starting pay. A career may appear in both a match column and the lifestyle column. Lifestyle options are deduplicated across education routes, each of which retains the student page's five-option cap. Extra eligible careers beyond the student list appear only in the drill-down's explicitly labeled additional-options section.

The cohort bars partition models into: at least one top match covers; only another option covers; none covers; lifestyle not assessed. Search, field, cohort and lifestyle filters apply to bars, table, totals and CSV together. Pagination changes only the visible table page; CSV includes all models in the filtered view. Click a cohort segment to select its cohort and lifestyle result. Reset restores all currently authorized models.

Click a model or career to follow profile → six RIASEC totals → original and current pathway offers → recorded field choice and reason → follow-up evidence → career offers → starting-pay budget → recorded choices. Correlations and task evidence points are shown alongside actual supporting questions. Starting-pay coverage requires the existing budget check, the displayed gross-income threshold and no prerequisite role experience. Paid training uses its first paid stage; later modeled pay does not qualify. Salary labels reuse the student renderer's rounding.

Frozen records contain conditional career previews, not final student career decisions. The chart therefore labels the field choice, final career choice (Not recorded), and stored comparison preview separately. Original engine suggestions remain available in the drill-down even when the new presentation's top-three display differs. Existing model-review links open the exact life-history, score, answer, follow-up, lifestyle or plan section; containing disclosures open automatically.

Public rows are generated by scripts/build-model-match-chart.mjs from the frozen public case files, using dist/model-match-audit.js and the same planMatchCandidates function as student results. Six private cases are fetched through the existing authenticated owner-only storage, computed in memory and excluded from public JSON, source commits and static output. Authentication changes clear private rows, cached cases and open profile details. This page does not write to a real student's guide or modify the frozen answers.

All 148 public cases are checked against the exact student top/other/education lists. The six owner-only cases are also replayed locally without copying their results into public files. Counts partition each model once. The public cohort counts are 68 with a top match covering the lifestyle, 52 with another option covering, and 28 with no offered option covering. These are software scenario results, not measured career accuracy or student outcomes.

Verification: all 516 software tests pass. Browser checks cover desktop and 390px phone layouts, cohort/reset, search, one-model CSV, profile trails, career evidence, budget arithmetic and direct answer links. The public-output scan found none of 79 private biography fragments.
